scripts.android:sync: npm run build && npx cap sync android
scripts.android:apk: npm run android:sync && cd android && ./gradlew assembleDebug
scripts.android:setup: npm run build && npx cap add android && node scripts/set-android-min-sdk.cjs && npx cap sync android
scripts.android:update: npm run build && node scripts/set-android-min-sdk.cjs && npx cap sync android
